name: firecrawl
description: Search the web, scrape any page into clean Markdown or structured data, and interact with live pages through the hosted Firecrawl MCP server.
suggestedPrompts: Use Firecrawl to find the current upgrade guide for this project's main framework and list what we'd need to change
Scrape the pricing pages of our top three competitors into a comparison table
Map the docs site for a library we use and summarize the pages relevant to this feature
